title: How Real Are Synthetic Therapy Conversations? Evaluating Fidelity in Prolonged Exposure Dialogues
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the clinical fidelity and protocol adherence of synthetic therapy dialogues generated by LLMs. While it mentions medical ethics and data privacy in passing and includes an ethical concerns section, its primary objective is benchmarking therapeutic accuracy (e.g., SUDS monitoring, avoidance handling) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, general morals, or ethics.
